metadata.case_name: HO MAN WA v. WONG SHUI FUN T/A YAU LEE CO AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fracture at shaft of the right femur.
source: X-ray also showed fracture at shaft of the right femur.

injuries.description: heterotopic ossification was noted at the tip of the greater trochanter (which was the entry site for insertion of intramedullary nail)
source: heterotopic ossification was noted at the tip of the greater trochanter (which was the entry site for insertion of intramedullary nail)
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at hip or thigh level

injuries.description: several surgical scars over the lateral aspect of right hip.
source: several surgical scars over the lateral aspect of right hip.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Swelling and tenderness over the right thigh.
Plaintiff might still have some residual pain in his right hip and knee.
Maximal tenderness and pain complained by the Plaintiff at the tip of the greater trochanter.
Several surgical scars over the lateral aspect of right hip (non-tender).

Right hip and knee found to have full range of movement with no pain; muscle power of right hip and knee were full; able to squat fully with no pain; walking and running with normal gait; sitting and standing with no limitation.

treatments_received: closed reduction and internal fixation with IM nail (emergency operation on 19th June 2005)
